transcript.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Could you switch our autopay to our other card, 4111 1111 1111 1111, for Org quarry-labs?
I can’t change your autopay card from support. For your security, please don’t send card details here. No changes were made; update the card yourself in **Console → Billing settings**.
And where do I manage our payment cards myself?
Go to **Console → Billing settings** to manage the card used for autopay. Please enter card details only in the Console, not in chat.
